postcard.title: The view
postcard.note: Down from Douliana to the water. Two chairs under a thatch umbrella, a still bay, white houses climbing the hill. One of those would be a good contender for an investment.
postcard.caption: Umbrella 3, two chairs, the bay still. That house on the hill would be a good contender for an investment.

word.meaning: The view. This morning, that’s the whole assignment.
